label: WhatsApp Business Platform (voice notes)

ingest.note: Voice notes arrive as OGG container, OPUS codec only, mono (audio/ogg; codecs=opus). Meta does not document a pinned sample rate; 16 kHz is the common Opus voice setting — verify against real inbound media before assuming. No live stream: media is downloaded over HTTPS after the webhook.

egress.note: Native voice-note rendering requires OGG/OPUS mono. MP3/AAC/AMR sent as type audio deliver fine but render as a plain audio file, not a voice note.

cost_estimates.notes: Modeled path (user-initiated voice note, reply inside the open customer-service window): free — service conversations have been free since 2024-11-01 and utility templates inside an open window are free. Outside the window you must send template messages, billed per delivered message since 2025-07-01 (rate varies by category, country code, and volume tier — see the rate card, not this pack).

interruption.description: Asynchronous message exchange — there is no live audio stream, so barge-in, turn gap, and VAD do not apply. Barge-in answers on this surface are wrong, not conservative.

lifecycle: 2024-11-01: service conversations became free for all businesses.
2025-07-01: per-message pricing replaced conversation-based pricing for delivered template messages; volume tiers introduced.
2026-01-01 onward: India mandatory INR billing localization (complete by 2026-12-31); Brazil BRL from 2026-07-01.

potholes.note: Async file exchange, not a call: replies land as chat messages seconds-to-minutes later. A design with a turn-gap SLO or barge-in plan on this surface is a category error — flag it, do not tune it.
Egress must be OGG/OPUS mono for native voice-note rendering; wrong codec or stereo often plays distorted or renders as a non-voice audio file.
Inbound media URLs from webhooks expire in minutes (media IDs last days); download media when the webhook arrives, not from a later queue replay.
Audio media cap is 16 MB; long notes must be chunked, refused, or moved to another surface — decide before launch.
MIME type must match the actual container (error 131053); verify files with `file`-style checks at the boundary.
Confirm the STT pack accepts OGG/Opus 16 kHz mono input before skipping a decode step; otherwise you own an opus→PCM transcode in the worker.
The 24-hour customer-service window bounds free replies; handoff/callback flows that answer later need template messages and per-message pricing.

deployment.self_host_notes: API service — nothing to self-host. Your worker receives webhooks, downloads media, and posts replies; region choice is about the STT/LLM legs, not this channel.
